text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important task is image recognition, which allows a computer to identify what is in a picture, such as a person, an animal, or an object. Another key task is object detection, which not only recognises objects but also finds where they are in the image. These technologies have many useful applications in our daily lives. For example, self-driving cars use computer vision to detect other cars, pedestrians, and traffic signs, so they can drive safely. Computer vision is also used in security cameras, medical imaging, and mobile phones.
